notes.title: Regular Update #1
notes.content:
\[New Content]

All heroes now have starting skills.

\[Modifications]

Adjusted all heroes' skill sets to enhance class diversity.

Glacial effect reworked.

Glacial 1: Beast HP +25% → More special beasts spawn

Glacial 2: Light the campfire cost +5 → Beast HP +30%

\[Bug Fixes]

Fixed various issues that caused the game to stuck.
